# AGENTS.md

Repository instructions for AI coding agents. Keep this file short, concrete, and tied to commands that actually work in this
repo. If a fact here conflicts with source files or CI config, trust the source file and update this guide.

## Project Snapshot

Memos is a self-hosted note-taking app.

- Backend: Go 1.26.2, Echo v5, Connect RPC, gRPC-Gateway, Protocol Buffers.
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript 6, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, React Query v5.
- Storage: SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL.
- Generated API outputs: `proto/gen/` for Go/OpenAPI, `web/src/types/proto/` for TypeScript.

## Working Rules

- Read relevant code before editing; prefer local patterns over new abstractions.
- Keep diffs scoped. Do not do repo-wide cleanup, dependency churn, or generated-file rewrites unless the task requires it.
- Do not hand-edit generated proto outputs. Change `.proto` files, then run `buf generate`.
- Add migrations for all database drivers when schema changes, and update each driver's `LATEST.sql`.
- Add public API endpoints to `server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go`.
- Ask before adding heavy dependencies, changing auth/token behavior, or altering Docker/release workflows.

## Commands

Run from the repository root unless a command starts with `cd`.

```bash
# Backend
go run ./cmd/memos --port 8081    # Start backend dev server
go test ./...                      # Run all Go tests
go test -v ./store/...             # Store tests, including DB drivers via TestContainers
go test -v -race ./server/...      # Server tests with race detector
go test -v -race ./internal/...    # Internal package tests with race detector
go test -v -run TestFoo ./pkg/...  # Run matching Go tests
go mod tidy -go=1.26.2             # Match CI tidy check
golangci-lint run                  # Go lint, config: .golangci.yaml
golangci-lint run --fix            # Auto-fix lint, including goimports

# Frontend
cd web && pnpm install             # Install dependencies
cd web && pnpm dev                 # Dev server on :3001, proxying API to :8081
cd web && pnpm lint                # Type check + Biome lint
cd web && pnpm test                # Vitest unit tests
cd web && pnpm build               # Production build
cd web && pnpm release             # Build SPA into server/router/frontend/dist

# Protocol Buffers
cd proto && buf generate           # Regenerate Go + TypeScript + OpenAPI
cd proto && buf lint               # Lint proto files
cd proto && buf format -w          # Format proto files
```

## Code Map

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cmd/memos/main.go` | Cobra/Viper CLI setup and server startup |
| `server/server.go` | Echo HTTP server and background runner wiring |
| `server/auth/` | JWT access tokens, refresh tokens, PAT handling |
| `server/router/api/v1/` | Connect/gRPC-Gateway services, ACL config, SSE hub |
| `server/router/frontend/` | Static SPA serving |
| `server/router/fileserver/` | Native HTTP file serving, thumbnails, range requests |
| `server/runner/` | Background memo processing and S3 presign refresh |
| `store/` | Store facade, cache, migrations, driver interface |
| `store/db/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}/` | Database-specific drivers and SQL |
| `proto/api/v1/` | Public API service definitions |
| `proto/store/` | Internal storage proto messages |
| `internal/` | App-private packages: scheduler, cron, email, CEL filter, markdown, idp, S3 |
| `web/src/connect.ts` | Connect RPC clients, auth interceptor, access-token refresh |
| `web/src/auth-state.ts` | Token storage and BroadcastChannel cross-tab sync |
| `web/src/hooks/` | React Query hooks for server state |
| `web/src/contexts/` | React context for client/UI state |
| `web/src/components/` | Radix/Tailwind UI components and feature components |
| `web/src/themes/` | CSS themes using OKLch color tokens |

## Change Routing

| Change | Update | Verify |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Go service or router behavior | Service code under `server/`, tests near package | `go test -v -race ./server/...` |
| Store or migration behavior | `store/`, all three DB driver migrations, `LATEST.sql` | `go test -v ./store/...` |
| Internal package logic | Relevant `internal/` package tests | `go test -v -race ./internal/...` |
| Frontend behavior | Components/hooks/contexts under `web/src/` | `cd web && pnpm lint && pnpm test` |
| Frontend production output | Vite config or release-sensitive UI | `cd web && pnpm build` or `pnpm release` |
| Proto API | `.proto` source plus generated outputs | `cd proto && buf generate && buf lint` |
| Public unauthenticated route | `server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go` | Targeted server test or manual route check |

## Go Conventions

- Wrap errors with `errors.Wrap(err, "context")` from `github.com/pkg/errors`; do not use `fmt.Errorf`.
- Return service errors with `status.Errorf(codes.X, "message")`.
- Keep imports grouped as stdlib, third-party, then `github.com/usememos/memos`; goimports is run by golangci-lint.
- Add doc comments for exported identifiers; godot enforces exported comment punctuation.
- Avoid package-level mutable state unless the surrounding package already uses that pattern.

## Frontend Conventions

- Use `@/` for absolute imports.
- Follow Biome formatting: 2-space indent, double quotes, semicolons, 140-character line width.

I have completed my exploration of the codebase. I am now preparing a structured summary of the project type, RPC handler locations, and HTTP-related patterns.

Here is a structured summary of the codebase based on exploration of the root and main source directories.

## 1. Project Type

This is **Memos** — an open-source, self-hosted note-taking application ([usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos)).

| Layer | Stack |
|---|---|
| Backend | Go 1.26.2, Echo v5 HTTP server |
| API | Protocol Buffers, **Connect RPC**, gRPC-Gateway (REST), SSE |
| Frontend | React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind (in `web/`) |
| Storage | SQLite / MySQL / PostgreSQL via `store/` |
| Entry point | `cmd/memos/main.go` (Cobra/Viper CLI) |

The server is wired in `server/server.go`: Echo mounts the SPA, file server, RSS, Connect/gRPC-Gateway API, and MCP routes.

---

## 2. Where RPC Handlers Are Defined

### API contract (source of truth)

- **`proto/api/v1/*.proto`** — service definitions with `google.api.http` annotations for REST mapping  
  Services: `InstanceService`, `AuthService`, `UserService`, `MemoService`, `AttachmentService`, `AIService`, `ShortcutService`, `IdentityProviderService`

### Generated code

- **`proto/gen/api/v1/`** — generated Go stubs, gRPC-Gateway handlers (`*.pb.gw.go`), Connect handlers (`apiv1connect/*.connect.go`)

### Handler implementations (business logic)

All live under **`server/router/api/v1/`** on a single struct:

```22:45:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
type APIV1Service struct {
	v1pb.UnimplementedInstanceServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedUserServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedMemoServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAttachmentServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAIServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedIdentityProviderServiceServer
	// ...
}
```

| File pattern | Role |
|---|---|
| `*_service.go` | gRPC method implementations (e.g. `memo_service.go`, `user_service.go`) |
| `connect_services.go` | Connect adapter methods that delegate to `APIV1Service` |
| `connect_handler.go` | Registers Connect handlers on an `http.ServeMux` |
| `v1.go` → `RegisterGateway()` | Registers both gRPC-Gateway (`/api/v1/*`) and Connect (`/memos.api.v1.*`) |
| `connect_interceptors.go` | Auth, logging, recovery, metadata interceptors |
| `acl_config.go` | Public vs authenticated RPC method allowlist |

### Registration flow

```64:146:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
func (s *APIV1Service) RegisterGateway(ctx context.Context, echoServer *echo.Echo) error {
	// gRPC-Gateway on /api/v1/* and /file/*
	// Connect handlers on /memos.api.v1.*
}
```

### Frontend RPC client

- **`web/src/connect.ts`** — Connect transport, auth interceptor, token refresh, typed clients for each service

---

## 3. HTTP Request Patterns

### Inbound HTTP (server)

| Route group | Handler location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/v1/*` | gRPC-Gateway in `v1.go` | REST API |
| `/memos.api.v1.*` | Connect in `connect_handler.go` | Browser RPC |
| `/file/*` | `server/router/fileserver/` | Native file/thumbnail serving |
| `/healthz` | `server/server.go` | Health check |
| SSE | `sse_handler.go`, `sse_hub.go` | Server-sent events |
| RSS | `server/router/rss/` | RSS feeds |
| MCP | `server/router/mcp/` | Model Context Protocol |
| SPA | `server/router/frontend/` | Static frontend |

Auth is centralized in `server/auth/` and applied via gateway middleware + Connect interceptors, using `acl_config.go` as the public-endpoint map.

### Outbound HTTP (client)

| Package | Pattern | Target URLs |
|---|---|---|
| **`internal/webhook/`** | `http.Client` with SSRF-safe dialer, async queue | User-configured webhook URLs |
| **`internal/httpgetter/`** | Secure client with IP validation, redirect checks | User-supplied link URLs (metadata) |
| **`internal/idp/oauth2/`** | `http.Client` + `golang.org/x/oauth2` | Admin-configured OAuth2 IdP URLs |
| **`internal/ai/`** | SDK clients (Gemini, OpenAI, etc.) with optional `http.Client` | Admin-configured AI provider endpoints |
| **`internal/httpgetter/image.go`** | Plain `http.Get` | External image URLs (less hardened than `html_meta.go`) |

Common outbound pattern for user-facing URLs:

1. Validate URL (scheme, hostname, IP resolution)
2. Block private/reserved IPs (SSRF protection)
3. Use bounded timeouts and response size limits
4. POST/GET via shared or per-call `http.Client`

---

## 4. HTTP to User-Configured URLs

The main user-configured outbound HTTP path is **webhooks**.

### Configuration & CRUD (RPC handlers)

**`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go`**

- `ListUserWebhooks`, `CreateUserWebhook`, `UpdateUserWebhook`, `DeleteUserWebhook`, `GetUserWebhookSigningSecret`
- URLs validated via `webhook.ValidateURL()` before storage
- Stored in user settings via `store/user_setting.go`

### Dispatch (triggered by memo events)

**`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`**

- `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- Loads user webhooks from store, builds payload, calls `webhook.PostAsync()`

Call sites: `memo_service.go`, `memo_update_helpers.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`

### Core HTTP dispatch

**`internal/webhook/webhook.go`**

```119:180:internal/webhook/webhook.go
func Post(requestPayload *WebhookRequestPayload) error {
	// POST JSON to requestPayload.URL
	// Optional HMAC signing (Standard Webhooks)
	// Uses safeClient with SSRF protection at dial time
}
func PostAsync(requestPayload *WebhookRequestPayload) { /* 4-worker queue */ }
```

**`internal/webhook/validate.go`** — URL validation, reserved IP blocking (overridable via `--allow-private-webhooks` in `cmd/memos/main.go`)

### Link metadata (user-supplied URLs in memos)

**`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_link_metadata.go`** → **`internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go`**

- RPC: `GetLinkMetadata`, `BatchGetLinkMetadata`
- Fetches Open Graph / HTML meta from URLs pasted in memos
- Uses SSRF-safe client (blocks internal IPs, validates redirects)

### Admin-configured (not end-user) URLs

- **OAuth2 IdP**: `UserInfoUrl`, `TokenUrl`, `AuthUrl` in `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`, configured via `idp_service.go` / deployment config
- **AI providers**: `internal/ai/` with instance-level settings
- **Deployment config**: `store/deployment_config.go` loads JSON from `/etc/secrets` at startup

---

## 5. Key Directories

```
/bench/repo/
├── cmd/memos/              # CLI entry point, profile/config, server startup
├── server/
│   ├── server.go           # Echo server assembly
│   ├── auth/               # JWT, sessions, PAT
│   ├── router/
│   │   ├── api/v1/         # ★ RPC handlers, Connect/gRPC-Gateway registration
│   │   ├── fileserver/     # File/thumbnail HTTP
│   │   ├── frontend/       # SPA static files
│   │   ├── mcp/            # MCP integration
│   │   └── rss/            # RSS feeds
│   └── runner/             # Background jobs (S3 presign, memo payload)
├── proto/
│   ├── api/v1/             # ★ API proto definitions
│   └── gen/                # Generated Go/Connect/gRPC-Gateway code
├── internal/
│   ├── webhook/            # ★ Outbound webhook HTTP + SSRF protection
│   ├── httpgetter/         # ★ Outbound link/image fetching
│   ├── idp/                # OAuth2 SSO outbound HTTP
│   ├── ai/                 # AI provider outbound calls
│   ├── email/              # Email sending
│   └── profile/            # Server profile (addr, port, data dir)
├── store/                  # DB layer, migrations, user settings (incl. webhooks)
└── web/                    # React frontend, Connect client in src/connect.ts
```

---

## Takeaways

1. **RPC handlers** are implemented as methods on `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/*_service.go`, exposed via both REST (gRPC-Gateway) and Connect.
2. **User-configured URL HTTP** is primarily **webhooks** (`internal/webhook` + `user_service_webhooks.go` + `memo_service_webhooks.go`) and **link preview** (`httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta` via `GetLinkMetadata` RPC).
3. **SSRF protection** is a recurring pattern: resolve hostname → reject private/reserved IPs → safe dialer; webhooks also support `--allow-private-webhooks` for local deployments.
4. **Configuration** flows from CLI flags/Viper (`cmd/memos`), instance settings in DB (`store/instance_setting.go`), user settings (`store/user_setting.go`), and optional deployment secrets (`store/deployment_config.go`).
